en: Summon a Great Owl pet (::+dps:: damage/sec). Activating this skill again will anger the Great Owl (::+dps2:: damage/sec). The Great Owl disappears if you take any damage.
Hoo hoo hoooo.
Infernal Chicken!
Increase your movement speed by ::+prct::% for ::+duration:: sec when you kill an enemy.
Dash forward and inflicts ::+power:: damage to the enemies on the way. Activate again to dash back.
Look behind you!
I said "Behind".
Inflict ::+power:: damage to the most dangerous enemy around... most dangerous ACCORDING to the Giant.
Give me five!
Leap in the air and violently land back on the ground to inflict ::+power:: damage to the enemies around.
Ready to rumble?
Spin the syringe around you to inflict damage. Activate again to add ::+dps:: damage/sec (up to 5 time) and ::duration:: secs, for a mere few cells.
Become the Spin Doctor.
Releases a cloud of smoke making you invisible for ::duration:: seconds. The first invisible attack inflicts +::*prct::% damage.
Mushroom Boi!

Spawns a friendly mushroom boi which charges and interrupts enemies inflicting ::+power:: damage and ::+power2:: extra damage if the enemy hits a wall. Trigger it again to inflict ::+power3:: damage and violate your soul.
Covers you in ice that absorbs one attack and explodes {freezing@IC} nearby enemies. If you don't take a hit it explodes after ::duration2:: seconds.
Place up to ::count:: lightning rods to attract lightning that strikes all enemies in between.
Comes back to you automatically. Inflicts increasingly severe {critical hits@CC} after each hit.
Perfect for pruning everything that sticks out.

Summons a flying sword that will mark enemies, trigger it again to inflict critical hits on them while holding the weapon, and vice-versa! The sword will vanish after ::duration2:: sec if you don't hit the marked enemies.
Grab Serenade to deal {critical damage@CC} on marked enemies.
Parries all around you dealing ::+power:: damage. A successful parry resets the cooldown.
Crush a flask on your forehead, dealing low damage to yourself.
Smashing red stuff in your own face is NEVER a good idea, ask the people of Tristram.
Turn into a chicken for a brief moment, firing several explosive eggs around you.
The cluck is ticking.

Summon a Leghugger that attacks your enemies, inflicting {critical hits@CC} on bleeding targets. Re-activate to make it attack in a circle around itself, making enemies hit {bleed@BL}.

The creature feeds by attacking your enemies. Once sated, it evolves into its stronger adult state.
Bloodthirsty and cute, what more could you ask?
Summon an adult Leghugger that attacks your enemies, inflicting {critical hits@CC} on bleeding targets. Re-activate to make it attack in a circle around itself, making enemies hit {bleed@BL}.

{Draw@CC}: you gain ::*life:: {bonus health@SH} that persists indefinitely. 
{Passive@CC}: Each successful {parry@PA} grants ::*count:: {bonus health@SH} for ::duration2:: sec and deal ::prct::% more damage.
{Discard@CC}: remove all current {bonus health@SH} and deal damage depending on the quantity removed.
At the core of an ancient strategy called "the 999 block".

{Passive@CC}: Your melee attacks {poison@TO} the enemies they hit.
{Discard@CC}: nearby enemies lose all their damage-over-time stacks then are dealt the remaining damage of these effects.
You can wait for the last straw to break the camel back... or push the poor beast yourself!

{Draw@CC}: creates a lightning orb that gravitates around you, dealing ::+power:: damage on impact.
{Passive@CC}: Each time you use your other skill, creates an additional orb (max: ::limit:: orbs).
{Discard@CC}: destroys all your active orbs. Thunder strikes a nearby enemy for each orb destroyed that way, dealing ::+power2:: damage.
Less hazardous when wearing a Faraday Outfit.

{Passive@CC}: You avoid the first damage source dealt to you. This effect recharges when you kill ::count:: enemies.
{Discard@CC}: you become immune to all sources of damage for ::duration:: sec.
You don't even know that I'm still not dead!
Taunts an enemy, causing it to frantically pursue you for ::duration2:: sec but take ::prct::% more damage from your melee attacks.
Requires Language (Old times) or Language (Foul) mastery.
Throws a magic stone that bounces on surfaces and moves faster after each bounce. Deals {critical hits@CC} and accelerates sharply after passing through you.
The words "Digital Video Disc" are engraved on the stone. Probably some sort of unholy incantation. Oddly satisfying when it hits corners.
